sloka: किमिदं कारणम् येन ममाज्ञा प्रतिहन्यते ।न चैव सम्प्रसुप्तोऽहमानयेहाशु राघवम् ॥२-१५-२७॥
transliteration: kimidaṁ kāraṇam yena mamājñā pratihanyate ।na caiva samprasupto'hamānayehāśu rāghavam ॥2-15-27॥

translations.english: I did not sleep (last night). Bring Rama here at once, said king Dasaratha to the charioteer again.
